contexts.text: He in divining divines in this () = that the Celestial knows hidden things from its own Divine.
Wot ye not that such a man as I in divining divines? () = that it cannot be hidden from him who sees things future and concealed.

They are all very much addicted to divining from themselves... so that when anything happens, everyone... divines that it is so and so... Thus the whole sphere would be filled with false conjectures.

The prophets who see vanity, and divine a lie () = all who are not taught and led by the Lord, but by themselves, whence they have insanity instead of intelligence, and folly instead of wisdom...
Darkness instead of divining () = falsities instead of revealed truths.

The reason the priests and diviners of the Philistines persuaded them to do so, was that the science of correspondences was the general science of that time; for their theology was known to the priests and diviners, who were their wise men.
